title: The Footy Tipping — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning AFL Perth sport
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The footy tipping competition at the office has its annual launch
In February and the entry fee is five dollars on the haunch
Of the season ahead and everyone believes with full sincerity
That this year they've worked out the system with maturity

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El concurso de pronósticos de fútbol empieza en febrero
[The footy tipping competition starts in February]
La entrada cuesta cinco dólares — un precio ligero y certero
[The entry costs five dollars — a light and certain price]
Y todos creen con toda sinceridad que este año
[And everyone believes with complete sincerity that this year]
Han descubierto el sistema perfecto sin el daño
[They have discovered the perfect system without damage]

[Chorus — English]
The footy tipping knows something I don't know
It knows that random chance beats analysis for the show
The footy tipping has an office champion every year
Who wins by accident and won't admit the role played by sheer
Luck — that's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le concours de pronostics de foot commence en février
[The footy tipping competition starts in February]
Cinq dollars d'entrée — chacun croit avoir trouvé le vrai
[Five dollars to enter — everyone believes they've found the truth]
Système infaillible pour cette saison qui commence
[Infallible system for this starting season]
Le footy tipping sait que la chance est la seule différence
[The footy tipping knows that luck is the only difference]

[Outro — All three languages]
Footy tipping knows… El pronóstico sabe… Le pronostic sait
Everyone thinks they know — Todos creen que saben — Tout le monde pense savoir
That's my boy
